notes: Voice replies no longer repeat the "I heard" receipt: the display header leaked into chat history and the model learned to parrot it. It is now stripped from output, never stored, and polluted histories are healed at startup.
notes_zh: 语音回复不再重复“我听到”回执——显示用的回执头曾进入聊天历史，模型学会了鹦鹉学舌。如今它从模型输出中剥离、永不被存储，被旧版本污染的历史会在启动时自动治愈。
